name: Crack the land-search artifact for an Urza's piece that is on neither my battlefield nor in my hand
intent: Applies when at least one Urza's piece - Tower, Mine or Power-Plant - has a copy in my library and no copy on my battlefield or in my hand, and fetches one such piece. Expedition Map shape. A piece is missing when none is on my battlefield or in my hand; a copy in my graveyard or exile does not assemble Tron, so that piece is still missing and still fetched. The count and the search answer both read missing_from over battlefield and hand by subtype, narrowed to the three Urza's subtypes (every Tron land shares the Urza's subtype itself), so one play applies exactly when a missing piece is available and none applies otherwise: no walk order, no gap for a copy in the graveyard or exile. With two or three pieces missing the answer prefers Tower, then Mine, then Power-Plant: assembled Tron makes seven mana from Tower's three and two each from Mine and Power-Plant, so Tower is the piece whose absence costs the most, and the order keeps the one the three earlier land-search plays walked. One play keeps five of the six active slots free.
